subject: Class 380 in ScotRail livery
method: No usable side diagram: both Commons drawings (First ScotRail, and the small pantograph view) are the 20 m Desiro UK template, while a 380 car is 23.78 m. The cab end is measured side-on on p107 (380107, Paisley) scaled from the cab door's height; the car's layout by a 1D projective fit along 380013's window line (cab door window from p107, car end at 23.78 m, both doors 1.64 m wide as measured on the 450); the face across by a symmetric projective fit on p002 (head-on) and up from p107's heights; heights of the body section are the 450's (the same Desiro UK body).

calibration.notes: p107 side-on: cab door 0.95-3.41 m = rows 589-1474 (360 px/m), its front edge at px 1570; rail at row 1816. p013: X(m) = (a m + b)/(c m + 1), a -3.058, b 929.3, c 0.0383 (residuals 0.2-4.3 px). p002: symmetric fit a 736.8, b 1825.3, c 0.2595 (half-width 1.40 m at sx 1250/2110). The overlay uses the small pantograph diagram (a 20 m template), for orientation only.

trace.body: heights: the 450's (the Desiro UK body section). Layout on the far side by the 1D fit on p013: cab door window centre 845 px = 2.375 m (p107: the window centred in the door), door 1 731.6-777 px and door 2 521-553 px (1.64 m each), car end 449 px = 23.78 m: door 1 centre 5.50 m, door 2 16.62 m (residuals 0.2-4.3 px); windows back-projected: 3.35-4.29, 6.75-7.94, 8.52-10.55, 11.12-13.23, 13.53-15.20, 18.04-20.13, 20.38-21.99 m. Bogies and car 2 are not measured (the old data's, car 2 rescaled to 23.57 m)
trace.cab.doors[0]: p107 side-on: the cab door outline 0.91 m wide, its front edge 1.92 m behind the gangway frame's foot (the nose tip); its window centred, in two panes
trace.nose.profile: p107 side-on: the gangway frame's front from 1.12 m (taken as the tip) leaning back 0.52 m by 3.73 m; the face's centreline 0.3 m behind it (the bellows' depth); the corner where face meets side 0.44 m behind the frame at 1.61 m, 0.58 m at 2.55 m and 0.69 m at 3.75 m (form.setback, less the face's own 0.3 m); the lower nose a bulge 0.12-0.15 m behind the tip from 0.5 to 1.15 m
trace.face: p002 head-on, symmetric projective fit (rms 23 px, the face is raked and curved): frame +-0.73 m, door +-0.52 m, glass +-0.88..1.35 m; heights on the frame's 2.61 m (349 px): glass 2.05-3.11 m, door 1.24-3.42 m; lamps: headlamp outboard (-1.02 m, 1.64 m), LED tail inboard (-0.80 m, 1.60 m) in one yellow trapezoid recess -1.25..-0.45 m, 1.44-1.84 m; the LED tail lowered to 1.565 m: through the camera solved on p013 (telephoto, 13440 px) it measures 1.54 m against p002s 1.60
trace.face.livery: p002, p013, p107: the face navy; yellow only as a thin rim round each screen's black surround and the lamp recess; the gangway door all yellow (two leaves) in a black frame on black bellows; white number over the near screen ('380 002'), the unit's last three digits over the far one
trace.livery: navy #1A2466 (p013 sunlit #101A68 and #2F407C), doors light grey (p107 #D3D5D2 white dots; doors #AEB3B9 by eye against them), yellow #EDB51C (p107 trims #B07415 in shade, p002 gangway #AC7B43 weathered): raw
trace.livery.saltire: p107 side-on: the white dot field behind the cab, its outline at 3.5 m 1.65-2.3 m from the tip, at 2.5 m 1.07-2.2, at 1.6 m 0.95-2.1, at 1.0 m 1.5-2.3; dots about 0.11 m across (44 px)
trace.livery.branding: SR (the ScotRail logo: dotted saltire, 'ScotRail', 'Scotland's Railway'), white, on the leading car between door 1 and door 2: 380013 (p013) through its projective fit along the car (X = (a m + b)/(c m + 1), calibration notes): the logo's ends at px 613.8 and 652.5 are 11.88 m and 9.87 m; up its side the window's foot (1.93 m, row 508) and the bodyside's foot (0.95 m, row 597) give 90.8 px/m there, so rows 512.5-570 are 1.88-1.25 m: 0.63 m tall against 2.0 m long (the artwork is 2.9 wide to 1 tall, so 0.66 m tall, 1.9 m long), centred 10.87 m, 1.565 m
trace.livery.endInset: 380013 (p013): the dotted saltire also flanks every gangway between cars (both car ends there), as the old data had it; its outline taken as the cab end's, 0.6 m nearer the car's end since there is no nose (read by eye on p013, not measured)
